comment: Node.js is declared in .node-version. The go package declares the Go release in packages/status-go/go.mod (its toolchain line) and the govulncheck release that the dependency review runs; the other language items (S-11 to S-14) add the toolchain of their kind. The npm kind (S-09-1) adds none, because it runs on the Node.js of .node-version and the kit declares npm only in a root package.json, which this repository does not have.
